verdict.rationale: Trello documents native capture from Slack into the Trello Inbox and a Power-Ups/app directory for linking the tools teams already use, plus a native Jira list view. However, the evidence never names GitHub or Google Drive, and one community report cites restrictive add-on limits for solo users. Missing for 10: explicit GitHub integration, explicit Google Drive integration, detail on the depth of the Slack integration, independent hands-on corroboration.
